en: A black-and-white photograph showing a snow-covered sanctuary built on a rocky outcrop amidst a forested and mountainous landscape. The structure has historical architectural features such as arched windows, a bell tower with a clock, and multiple connected buildings. Snow-laden tree branches frame the image in the foreground. There is Italian text at the bottom left of the image.
